newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: Yugo 1996 maize crop expected to fall to 5.1 mln T.
newsitem.headline: Yugo 1996 maize crop expected to fall to 5.1 mln T.

text.p: Yugoslav 1996 maize output is expected to drop this year to 5.1 million tonnes, despite an increase in the acreage under the crop, the federal statistics office said in its latest report.
Total area under maize was raised to 1.44 million hectares from last year's 1.37 million, the report said.
But a long summer drought is expected to cut average yield per hectare from 4.15 tonnes in 1995 to 3.54 tonnes.
Yugoslavia last year harvested 5.7 million tonnes of maize.
The institute based its forecasts on the state of the crop in early September.
Government and Belgrade Maize Institute officials last month forecast a six-million-tonne maize crop with an average yield of 4.2 tonnes per hectare.
